The '''Eschaton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a scatter of [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and a striped [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].<ref name="RE" />
